title: What's New: Enhanced Purchase Order Matching with Copilot (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Solution: Auto-Matching Capabilities and Line Addition
Demo: Learning Matching Rules with Item References

features.name: Support for All Entry Types
features.description: Extended matching support beyond general ledger accounts and items to include resources, item charges, and other entry types for electronic invoice matching.
features.status_evidence_quote: currently this is still a public preview
caveats: Learn matching rule only works for GL accounts and items, not for other types

features.name: Automatic Extra Line Addition from Invoice
features.description: Allows automatic addition of extra lines from inbound electronic invoices to purchase orders directly from the matching page without manual creation.
features.status_evidence_quote: currently this is still a public preview
caveats: Requires additional setup for certain line types

features.name: Item References for Auto-Matching
features.description: Uses item references to enable automatic matching in addition to string similarity matching, allowing the system to treat existing item references as auto-matching criteria without running LLM.
features.status_evidence_quote: currently this is still a public preview
caveats: Only applies when item references are already configured

features.name: Learn Matching Rule Feature
features.description: Allows users to mark matched lines in the matching page so the system automatically creates item references for future usage, enabling automatic matching on subsequent invoices.
features.status_evidence_quote: currently this is still a public preview
caveats: Only works for GL accounts and items, not for other line types

features.name: Create Purchase Order Line from Invoice
features.description: New simplified interface to quickly create purchase order lines from imported invoice lines, with automatic population of units of measure and cost.
features.status_evidence_quote: currently this is still a public preview
caveats: Simplified version available on matching page; more complex options available through purchase order directly

features.name: Auto-Matching Based on 80% Similarity
features.description: Existing functionality that performs automatic matching when string similarity reaches 80% or when item references are configured.
caveats: Requires 80% string similarity or existing item references

features.name: Copilot Matching with LLM
features.description: Existing Copilot functionality that uses large language models to match invoice lines with purchase order lines based on semantic understanding rather than string similarity.
caveats: May not match all lines if they are significantly different or have no item references
